## Summary
Thimathi Dissanayake is a multidisciplinary technology professional specializing in enterprise data engineering, full-stack software and mobile application development, product design, and affective computing research. He holds a Bachelor of Science (Honours) in Computer Science with First-Class Honours (72% overall aggregate) from the University of Wolverhampton (delivered via CINEC Campus).

## Current Professional Roles
- **Data Engineer** at CreativeX Technology (Pvt) Ltd (March 2026 – Present)
  - Spearheading enterprise relational and cloud data architecture across PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, GCP, and AWS.
  - Designing automated ingestion, validation, and analytics reporting pipelines.
- **Product Designer** at NONO AI (March 2025 – Present)
  - Leading user experience architecture, design systems, and interface prototyping for AI-driven products in parallel with data engineering responsibilities.

## Flagship Projects & Case Studies
- **Baby Mine** (https://www.thimathi.online/projects/baby-mine): All-in-one maternal and pediatric support platform built with React Native and Supabase PostgreSQL. Supports families from pregnancy through early childhood with health metric monitoring, automated vaccination alerts, and family support directories.
- **Aurevia** (https://www.thimathi.online/projects/aurevia): Affective multimodal AI framework exploring workplace burnout indicators and emotional well-being monitoring. Combines BERT textual representation (78% benchmark accuracy) with CNN acoustic spectrogram features (83% benchmark accuracy), achieving 85% multimodal late fusion accuracy on evaluated benchmarks (RAVDESS, TESS, GoEmotions). Prepared as lead author research for the 7th CINEC International Research Symposium (CIRS 2026).
  *Note: Aurevia is an affective computing research prototype rather than a clinically validated diagnostic device.*
